command:
set -euo pipefail
set -a
. "$HOME/.config/omega/omega-mcp.env"
set +a
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, urllib.request
url='http://127.0.0.1:8789/mcp'
token=os.environ['OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN']
def rpc(obj):
    data=json.dumps(obj,separators=(',',':')).encode()
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=data,method='POST',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json, text/event-stream'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as r: return json.loads(r.read().decode())
init=rpc({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'init-e2e','method':'initialize','params':{'protocolVersion':'2025-03-26','capabilities':{},'clientInfo':{'name':'omega-e2e','version':'1'}}})
tools=rpc({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'list-e2e','method':'tools/list','params':{}})
call=rpc({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'gabriel-status-e2e','method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'omega_status','arguments':{'person':'gabriel','wait_seconds':0}}})
names=[t['name'] for t in tools['result']['tools']]
payload=call['result']['structuredContent']
print(json.dumps({'server':init['result']['serverInfo']['name'],'tools':names,'status_stage':{'state':payload.get('state'),'command_id':payload.get('command_id'),'machine_id':payload.get('machine_id'),'owner':payload.get('owner')}},separators=(',',':')))
assert init['result']['serverInfo']['name']=='omega-frankenstein-bridge'
assert 'omega_status' in names and 'omega_execute' in names
assert payload.get('state')=='PENDING'
assert payload.get('machine_id')=='ai-core-node' and payload.get('owner')=='gabriel'
PY
